messages:
anya: heads-up — bringing up v2-multi-quant (4-bit NF4) for the summarize-long workflow. planning a staged promotion, want to lock down rollback thresholds before traffic hits.
sree: thanks. do we have the baseline metrics for longform? rouge-l / embedding sim / hallucination rate?
noah: baseline (prod v1): ROUGE-L 42.1, embedding cosine avg 0.872, hallucination rate ~1.8% (manual sampling on 2k queries).
elaine: spot-check of v2-multi-quant in shadow: ROUGE-L 41.6 (-0.5), embedding cos 0.860 (-0.012), hallucination ~2.9% (n=400). notable drop in factuality on legal-doc slice.
anya: okay, that delta on embeddings is subtle but hallucination jump is concerning. propose gating rules: keep shadow until embedding delta <0.01 AND hallucination delta <0.5% absolute.
sree: sounds reasonable. also want a statistical check on the embedding delta for n>=200 samples with p-value threshold 0.05. auto-rollback if effect size exceeds threshold.
noah: propose rollout plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with hold windows and automated checks between steps. if any step fails, immediate revert to pinned model.
elaine: we should also add a targeted slice weight — legal-docs and longcode slices get double sampling and slower ramp (0.1% -> 1% -> 5%).
anya: config snippet for the deploy job i drafted:

```
rollout:
  steps: [0.5, 5, 20, 100]
  hold_minutes: [30, 120, 360, 1440]
  auto_rollback:
    checks:
      - name: embedding_cosine_delta
        threshold: 0.01
        min_samples: 200
      - name: hallucination_absolute_delta
        threshold: 0.005
        min_samples: 200
      - name: rouge_l_delta
        threshold: -1.0  # allow up to 1.0 point drop
        min_samples: 200
  slices:
    legal-docs: {ramp: [0.1,1,5,100], monitor: high}
    longcode: {ramp: [0.1,1,5,100], monitor: medium}
```

dev-bot: deployment job created: deploy/rollout/1769999998; status: queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
noah: two operational notes — (1) KV-cache behavior differs for quant path; monitor cold-start tail. (2) add a latency SLO gate: if p95 latency increases >20% for a step, we abort.
sree: agreed. final checklist before we unfreeze: (a) eval harness run with 2k seeded queries + slices, (b) alerting wired for auto-rollback, (c) ops on-call primed. can someone sign off?
elaine: I'll run the 2k harness and share the results by EOD.
anya: I'll wire the alerting and confirm the auto-rollback webhook. if both green, we start shadow -> 0.5% tomorrow morning.
noah: on-call pinged. good to proceed once harness is clean.
anya: thanks — will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
